ios.desc:
Pop all arrows and clear the board as efficiently as you can with the least moves possible.

Arrows is a logical game with five game modes:
1. Challenges - pre-made levels with grid sizes 3x3 to 6x6. Get all stars to finish the game!
2. Survival - keep playing as long as you can with initial 20 moves. You get +1 move with each combo (3 arrows popped with one click).
3. Best Combo - find the longest chain of arrows on the grid. Play until you pick a wrong move.
4. Multiplayer vs Bot - play best combo game in 5 matches vs bot
5. Multiplayer vs Friend - play best combo game in 5 matches vs your friend

You can use hints to get yourself out of a pickle and try to get all achievements!

The core mechanic is simple. Touch the arrow which will start flying the direction it's aiming until it hits level boundary or another arrow which is automatically triggered.
